text_block_list.text: Spring has arrived once again.

"As cherry blossom petals dance through the sky,
and the green of young buds begins to peek out—"
(WOOOOOOO!)

The day of the Satsuki Sho.
When I headed to spectate with Sakura Laurel,
the stands were completely filled with fans.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The excitement is insane...!
Even though the race hasn't even started yet...
choice_data_list: So this is the first battle of the Classic Triple Crown road...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
The Classic campaign has begun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...Still, I couldn't make it in time.)

text_block_list.name: Young Person A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Biwa Hayahide's sister
is running this year, right!?"

text_block_list.name: Young Person B
text_block_list.text:
Right, exactly!
BNW's race last year was amazing,
so everyone's got high hopes for her sister too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
! ...Trainer,
look at the Turf Vision!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: They say Brian-chan is the race favorite.
choice_data_list: Let's see for ourselves how strong that 'running we admire' really is.
Let's also see for ourselves the strength of that "admired running style."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes. With my own two eyes, thoroughly!
And so, the Satsuki Sho began—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ORAAGHHH—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Narita Brian on the outside!
Narita Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Narita Brian!
She's pulling away! One length, two lengths!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The pack is chasing hard, but... they won't reach her!
What sheer power! Right on through to the finish...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian, a total rout! A crushing victory!
Three lengths ahead in the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Brian was just as formidable as we expected!
Tremendous! She's taken the first step toward the Triple Crown!"
It was nothing short of pure fervor.
(UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth A
text_block_list.text:
What the heck!? Her strength is completely off the charts!
What is she even...?! ...Nghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth B
text_block_list.text: The strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth B
text_block_list.text:
The strongest! Truly the strongest!
The one standing before us now is surely the 'strongest in history' who will rewrite everything...!

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth B
text_block_list.text: "We finally get to witness history in the making—the birth of a legend!"

text_block_list.name: Excited Youth A
text_block_list.text:
"A Triple Crown Umamusume! Narita Brian is—
she's going to be our Triple Crown Umamusume!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...How... incredible.
choice_data_list: We got totally absorbed in it too, huh.
We ended up totally captivated too, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
With running that will conquer everything...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(The next leg of the Classic Triple Crown is the Derby.
A showdown at the summit... open only to Classic-class girls.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Next time... I will, too...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I want to beat her too!
In the next Derby, I'll be the one! I'll become someone who can surpass that running of hers—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I want to win...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Narita Brian...
Next up is the Derby, huh...

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
We have to go watch it!
It's going to be a legendary Derby!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Even Narita Brian's sister fought a desperate battle in the Derby!
We've gotta send her all our cheers and support!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even out in the city,
everyone's talking about Brian-chan and nothing else...!
choice_data_list: Once you see that run, you'll never forget it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm. Indeed—

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Just like with BNW last year,
the Classic Triple Crown really is something incredible.

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
Right~! But the Nippon Derby
is totally different from the Satsuki Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
It's the dream stage for everyone involved in racing, so to speak...
And the hype is on a whole other level! It's incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: The Derby...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At that moment, the wind blew. The fresh post-spring greenery swayed, and I felt I could hear the faint, delicate rustle of leaves...
